cases.name: Grace Zielinska
cases.about:
Her former landlord Paul Klabonski said before the vigil began that Zielinska was a good person and doting mom. “She was a sweetheart,” Klabonski said. “She was a great mother. The kids were with her 24/7. She took such great care of those kids, I just can’t imagine them being without her.”

https://www.ctpost.com/news/article/She-was-a-sweetheart-Ansonia-domestic-16626904.php
cases.narrative: Police found him standing over her with a black axe and a curved knife.
